I'm not able to see any images in this conversation — no CT slices were actually attached. Please re-upload the images and I'll gladly assess them.

For reference, here's how I would decide: a **nodule** appears as a rounded opacity that stays in roughly the same position with similar size across consecutive slices and then disappears, without connecting tubular branches; a **vessel** typically changes position slice-to-slice, elongates, or connects to branching tubular structures on adjacent slices. Diameter would be measured on the slice where the structure is largest.
